Name: Censys Supplier Risk
Author: Censys - support@censys.com
Description: Bring Censys Supplier Risk into Microsoft Sentinel. The solution collects supply chain risk events (risks opened, reopened and resolved for your suppliers) from the Censys platform, and provides a parser, a workbook and an analytic rule that raises incidents for new and reopened supplier risks and keeps resolved events with the incident of the same risk.
